purpose: R3 quant gate for Qwen3.5-0.8B: two FP8 exports (per-tensor and per-channel, calib 128, ModelOpt) vs the bf16 parent, paired on OCRBench regression_500, same vLLM engine settings

models.fp8_block_weight_only: outputs/runs/20261013-2133-research-quant-block-calib128/ptq/quantized (quant_algo fp8_pb_wo: block-scaled FP8 weights, bf16 activations; research re-export)

benchmark.name: OCRBench
benchmark.citation: Liu et al., OCRBench: On the Hidden Mystery of OCR in Large Multimodal Models, Science China Information Sciences 2024 (arXiv:2305.07895)
benchmark.comparability: measured in this app on a 500-question subset: not comparable with model-card OCRBench numbers; only the paired deltas are gate numbers

fp8_block_wo_minus_bf16.note: same accuracy as per-channel by coincidence: 24/500 questions score differently between the two FP8 models; weight-only, so not the same speed class as W8A8 per-tensor/per-channel

reading: both FP8 exports are within noise of bf16 on the point estimate (-0.4 and -0.2); per-tensor gets WARN uncertain_run_full because its CI reaches -2.2 (500 questions cannot exclude a -2 drop); per-channel PASS. Engine noise for 0.8B is larger than for 2B (+0.4 points, 4 answers).
caveats: vLLM batched greedy is not bit-reproducible run to run (4/500 answers changed between two bf16 runs)
one benchmark only; P002 forgetting check on general benchmarks not part of this gate
block run is weight-only FP8 (fp8_pb_wo, re-exported by research after the first block export failed to load on vLLM 0.31); it is compared on accuracy only
